## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising and SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION show mixed short-term fear and market pullback, while sector breadth remains narrow.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity shock: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND driving inflation and rotation into Energy. Credit/liquidity softening is mild: HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND show slight risk-off pressure in IG/high-yield.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: SPY_TLT NEUTRAL with TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling) signaling higher yields, while HYG/LQD are modestly negative — conditions mixed for risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Narrow leadership: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials (sector: 1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION leave style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US showing short-term weakness: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION while EM/China mixed — EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) CORRECTION; IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) ABOVE TREND signals pockets of risk-on in crypto.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) but ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) BELOW TREND show reduced small-cap/speculative breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength led by oil and grains: CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, WEAT (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +14.32%) ABOVE TREND; gold GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY and silver SLV (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -6.59%) RECOVERY are seeing tactical flows.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy dominant: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ↑ rising and commodity oil ETFs BNO/USO ABOVE TREND make Energy a primary market leadership vector; natural gas UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy/Commodities strength (XLE, BNO, USO ABOVE TREND) and narrow sector breadth (only 3/11 positive) create a guarded picture; major divergences include QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND and TLT BELOW TREND (synchronized weakness across growth and duration) — suppress strong regime bets.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy and commodity-linked ETFs (XLE, BNO, USO) and monitor credit (HYG | LQD); reduce exposure to Tech momentum and small-cap risk (XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%)) while bonds remain under pressure (TLT BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation. BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and Communication (sector 1W: -4.40% | 1M: -3.77%) showing weakness to monitor.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/oil ETFs BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Industrial metals/precious metals divergence — SLV (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -6.59%) RECOVERY shows 1M softness to watch.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (fear threshold) to watch for volatility regime change; HYG/LQD spread and direction (HYG 1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34% BELOW TREND; LQD 1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09% BELOW TREND) as credit pivot; XLE momentum sustaining above current 1W gains (XLE 1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) confirms commodity-driven regime.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, confirmed by VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) and SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%). Energy and commodity ETFs (XLE, BNO, USO) are showing strength while Tech and small-cap ETFs (XLK RECOVERY; IWM BELOW TREND) are key divergences to monitor.
